rv.q: Directors Jim Corti and Johanna Mckenzie Miller (Paramount debut) and this talented ensemble seamlessly tell Carole’s story to the fullest extent.
I sincerely think that Beautiful is easily the best of the jukebox musicals and that this production is stellar in every possible way.
This magnificent production is quite simply, “Some Kind of Wonderful!”
Beautiful delivers one fine night of theater at the Paramount...
It might be an oxymoron to call a toe-tapping and funny musical gripping, but “Beautiful: The Carole King Musical” playing at Aurora’s Paramount Theatre is just that.
With the abundantly talented Tiffany Topol as King, backed by a great cast, the new production of “Beautiful” at Aurora’s Paramount Theatre is irresistible—the audience was helpless before it.
"Beautiful: The Carole King Musical" is an exceptional piece of art that holds a special place in my heart.
Tonight, at The paramount Theatre in Aurora, we saw a magical production of "Beautiful: The Carole King Story" that will knock your socks off!
“Beautiful: The Carole King Musical” is a must-see for anyone who appreciates great music, compelling storytelling, and the power of perseverance.

cn.t: Critics praise this "magical" and "captivating" production, with Tiffany Topol's honest, layered performance as Carole King earning particular acclaim. The show impresses audiences with its emotional resonance and King's staggering catalog of hits.
